title: Prepared Transaction Remediation after F-VQ60

FVQ60-B1.problem: unchecked int64 transaction revision successor could wrap at INT64_MAX
FVQ60-B1.remediation: all successor checks route through safe_revision_successor; INT64_MAX-1 to INT64_MAX remains legal; an origin at INT64_MAX returns GW_EXCHANGE_REVISION_EXHAUSTED before trial_backend
FVQ60-B1.qualification: O0 and O2 with -fcheck=all and floating-point traps; boundary test proves legal max candidate and fail-closed exhausted-origin path without backend trial side effect

FVQ60-B2.problem: intrinsic copies of prepared handles could replay an opaque prepare token unless a backend independently supplied one-shot identity
FVQ60-B2.remediation: the preparable service owns a private slot-generation registry; commit and abort atomically consume exact wrapper reservation identity before backend callback; stale copies cannot reach irreversible publication
FVQ60-B2.qualification: copied abort and copied commit replay are rejected; exact backend token reuse is forced and shown unable to alias the new generation

scaling_remediation.registry_storage: O(peak concurrent prepared reservations per preparable service)
scaling_remediation.reserve_release: O(1) free-list operations except amortized geometric pool growth
scaling_remediation.same_service_mutation_ownership: exclusive runtime ownership required; unsynchronised concurrent mutation of one service object is outside the local contract

hard_nonclaims: F-VQ60 remains a frozen blocked verifier authority and is not rewritten by this owner remediation.
Owner qualification does not substitute for independent qualification.
GC18/GC18R is still absent from integration/f-ci-canonical at this owner closeout.
No claim is made here that the full production coupling stack is admitted or Status-A complete.
required_next_step: Start a new independent F-VQ requalification from the then-current integration/f-ci-canonical, preserve this owner candidate as immutable evidence, re-run full GC18/GC18R transaction and adversarial B1/B2 qualification, and only after independent success consider a separate canonical-admission workunit.
